note: Owner decisions D-38 and D-39 (2026-08-24). Baseline: OpenAI serves classify and ask on gpt-5.6-luna (cost tier) and generate and repair on gpt-5.6-terra (middle tier). Anthropic serves judge on claude-opus-5 (D-430, amends D-4) so the judge never shares the generator's provider (D-22). Model ids verified against developers.openai.com/api/docs/models and the claude-api skill on 2026-08-24. No bake-off has run yet: PR-15 measures these defaults. Override one field with LLM_<ROLE>_<PROVIDER|MODEL|EFFORT>. Judge (D-4, 2026-08-24): thinking stays on (Sonnet 5 runs adaptive thinking when the request omits the thinking field). Effort is medium, not high, so a judge answer fits the 8192-token cap and the 120-second attempt timeout. A truncation retry escalates the cap to 65536, and high effort at that cap can outrun the timeout. Eval (D-133, 2026-08-26): the automated question scorer runs on gpt-5.6-luna, the cost tier, so a whole run of the 104-conversation set costs cents. That model also serves classify and ask, so the eval role rates work its own model produced. `make eval-calibrate` measures that bias against claude-opus-5 on a sample (D-428). Override with LLM_EVAL_MODEL. Revise (D-283, D-284): the revision brief after a build runs on gpt-5.6-terra at low effort, the same provider as generate, because the brief and the build must read a request the same way.
